title: Text requests take a new route
summary:
The text API got a new route for OpenAI-backed requests, simpler streaming, and fewer provider-specific surprises.

OpenAI model aliases, OpenAI-backed personas, search, and referral processing now use a gateway client instead of connecting directly to Azure OpenAI. Existing aliases still map to their Azure deployments.

Streaming response handling was simplified, including a single SSE [DONE] event. API errors now preserve provider details.

Cloudflare requests no longer include an unsupported seed parameter, and the shared client adds a default system prompt only when the selected model has one configured.
